title: Great Mirror
text: Great Mirror. I was looking to take my wood framed mirror that set on my dresser off and wanted a large round mirror to fill that wall space this was perfect it’s beautiful classy modern I love it

product_metadata.title: NeuType Round Mirror Circle Mirror 28 Inch Aluminum Alloy Frame Wall Mirror Large Vanity Hanging Decorative Mirrors for Entryway, Bathroom, Bedroom, Living Room, Golden
features: BEAUTIFUL ROUND WALL MIRROR: Round style frame design makes it so popular and provides a rich and warm complement to the mirror. You can easily update your room with this beautiful round mirror.
HIGH-QUALITY FRAME & EXQUISITE WORKMANSHIP - The frame is made of anti-rust aluminum alloy, is of high rigidity, not easy to deform. Smooth edges and sturdy hardware pieces provides ultra-safety.
WALL DECOR MIRROR: Equipped with Hooks on the back, the mirror can be mounted on the wall with ease. The round mirror makes the room larger and brighter and it is also can be as a wall decor.

HIGH DEFINITION & SHATTER-PROOF: The round mirror is coated with silver nitrate, anti-rust treatment, no oxidize nor rust, high definition reflection with non-distortion. Copper-free silver mirror, environmentally friendly. The circle mirror is treated with a high viscosity shatter-proof membrane, shattered glass will not be spilled out even impacted by external force, safer and more protective.
WIDE APPLICATION: The circle wall mirror can be used as bathroom mirror, vanity mirror or entry mirror, add classy to your space!
